title: xenophyllum incisum
intro: Xenophyllum incisum, commonly known as "Mexican Gold Poppy," is a plant species native to Mexico, characterized by its unique, golden-colored flowers and edible properties. This plant is valued for its medicinal and nutritional benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, boost the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Xenophyllum incisum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
